question: How is the per-magnification GCR camera-recoil value consumed (traced through the six weapons of the 2.1.1.0 SU-230 fix), did the ladder change from 1.4.3.5 to 2.1.1.0, can a unit be established from source, and does a visual-recoil chip qualify as a proposal?

sourceFacts.fact: Control (1.4.3.5): 14-rung ladder strictly monotonic -0.5 (1.00x) .. 0.762266 (10.00x); all 128 enabled members on a rung; SU-230 state 2 = -0.5, state 1 = 0.505185.
All 34 GCR_* files are byte-identical between 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0 (raw SHA-256 per file in l4071-result.json rows); 320 typed reads on 2.1.1.0 match.
GCR operand pattern: enable Field_bbffe8bc true + override Field_bbbfe9cc on Field_9532eb28 and Field_7f1bb9d4 only; multiply/add slots neutral; Field_36c2f877 never enabled.

Six weapons: GS Class_539cff9b Field_a2bef75b[35] binds selector f66c9ab7 (priority 37) to GCR_LPVO_4x00_1x00_P00 in both builds; GS own values CameraRecoilAmount -1.4, CameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount -0.625, IdleCameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount -0.625 in both builds.

Registry GRX_Weapons rows GS_<w>.CameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount / IdleCameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount default -0.625 (min -10, max 10) and CameraRecoilAmount -1.4 for the six; paired to Class_539cff9b/Field_9532eb28, Field_7f1bb9d4, Field_36c2f877 by pair-status.json (19 Oct recheck).

WPM_SCP_ElcanDR Class_bfd4f199 objects 7 (Field_c4814c93 2) and 16 (Field_c4814c93 1): Field_149939ab and Field_e9129d03 1.0005 (1.4.3.5) -> 0.55 (2.1.1.0); Class_897c99a7 Field_819acc98 = [f66c9ab7]; imported by 56 weapon WBs in both builds.

inference: The GCR modifier replaces (overrides) the weapon zoomed camera-recoil own values while the optic is in a given zoom state; it does not multiply them. Field_1258dac5 is the zoom-state index (inferred from structure and values).
The 2.1.1.0 SU-230 fix is not in GCR values or bindings; the only SU-230-specific source change found is the shared-part pair Field_149939ab/Field_e9129d03, whose meaning is not established.
No unit follows from source: the target is a signed scalar with no named unit or consumer equation.
unresolved: Unit and runtime equation of CameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount / IdleCameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount: the source gives a signed scalar (weapon own value -0.625, registry bounds -10..10) that the GCR modifier replaces (enable + override, neutral multiply/add). No consumer equation was found, so neither a unit nor a direction is established from source; "higher = less shake" rests only on the 1.4.3.0 operator report.

Field_1258dac5 is read as the optic zoom-state index (1, 2, ...; -1 in GCR_01x00_ALLADS_P00) from structure; which index is the in-game 1x or 4x state is inferred from the ladder values, not from a consumer.

Why EA names six weapons: the SU-230-specific 2.1.1.0 change (WPM_SCP_ElcanDR Field_149939ab / Field_e9129d03 1.0005 -> 0.55) is in a part imported by 56 weapon WBs; no six-weapon-specific difference was found in the traced GS/WB/Ability chain. The pair is unnamed; that it is what EA calls visual recoil is not established.
A "ladder ratio" prediction is not defined for signed overrides (-0.5 against 0.762266); the recording can test direction and order only.
siteImpact: No site change. The site has no camera-recoil model and SIGHTS su_230_lpvo is noEffect:true; that stays correct for every modeled stat, because GCR_* bind only GS Class_539cff9b Field_9532eb28 / Field_7f1bb9d4 (CameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount / IdleCameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount), which the sim does not read. Conditional, only after the validation recording: if camera kick changes with the optic while bullet holes do not, a display-only optic-row chip could show the stored override as is ("zoomed camera recoil -0.5 ... 0.762266", unitless; weapon own value -0.625 on 61 weapons, -0.25 on es57/ggh22/m45a1/p18, +0.25 on m44/m357trait), never as a multiplier or percent. If no difference is seen, nothing changes. The 2.1.1.0 SU-230 fix changed no GCR value, so no site value changed with it.

evidence.helperNotes: frosty-ebx-decode.py and frosty-raw-check.py are unmodified copies of the research repo scripts; decode_offsets.py wraps the copied decoder to record the absolute offset of every scalar.

Exploratory one-off python heredocs (prior-work search, patch-note lookup, crosswalk/site-data inspection) are not preserved verbatim.

leads.title: Camera recoil ladder (GCR_*) consumption and the 2.1.1.0 SU-230 fix
leads.summary: The 34 GCR_* files (14-rung ladder) are byte-identical on 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0 and override GS zoomed camera-recoil fields (own value -0.625) without a source unit; the six-weapon SU-230 binding is unchanged and the only SU-230 change is the unnamed WPM_SCP_ElcanDR pair Field_149939ab/Field_e9129d03 1.0005 -> 0.55.
leads.reopenWhen: A recording of one weapon with a 1.00x and a 10.00x optic (5-shot groups) shows camera kick differing while bullet holes match, or a consumer equation for CameraRecoilWhenZoomedAmount is found.

assets.question: Does the SU-230 camera-recoil modifier hold ladder values, and did it change in 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Enable + override on Field_9532eb28/Field_7f1bb9d4: zoom state 2 = -0.5 (1.00x rung), state 1 = 0.505185 (4.00x rung); byte-identical to 1.4.3.5.

assets.question: Top rung of the GCR camera-recoil ladder on 2.1.1.0.
assets.conclusion: Override 0.762266 (10.00x) in both paired fields, enable true; byte-identical to 1.4.3.5.

assets.question: Bottom rung of the GCR camera-recoil ladder on 2.1.1.0.
assets.conclusion: Override -0.5 (1.00x) in both paired fields, enable true; byte-identical to 1.4.3.5.

assets.question: Where is the SU-230 change of 2.1.1.0 in the traced chain?
assets.conclusion: Only SU-230-specific change: Class_bfd4f199 objects 7 and 16 (Field_c4814c93 2 and 1) unnamed pair Field_149939ab/Field_e9129d03 1.0005 -> 0.55; part imported by 56 weapon WBs; meaning unresolved.

assets.question: How is the SU-230 GCR entry bound on this weapon, what does it target, and did the binding change in 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Field_a2bef75b entry 35: selector f66c9ab7, priority 37, GCR_LPVO_4x00_1x00_P00; own values -1.4/-0.625/-0.625; unchanged from 1.4.3.5. The other five named weapons (GRT-BC, M417 A2, M121 A2, M123K, M250) read the same; per-file hashes and checks are in the receipt body.
